# Contributing to Cull

Thanks for your interest in Cull! 🎉

Cull is a closed-source application. **The source code is maintained privately**,
and this repository exists only to host the public release binaries and project
documentation. As a result, we cannot accept code contributions to the
application itself.

That said, your input is genuinely valuable. Here is how you can help.

## Reporting Bugs

Found something broken? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/manishprivet/cull/issues/new/choose)
using the **Bug report** template. Helpful reports include:

- The version of Cull you are running
- Your operating system and version
- Clear steps to reproduce the problem
- What you expected to happen vs. what actually happened
- Screenshots, logs, or sample files where relevant (avoid sharing private photos)

## Requesting Features

Have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/manishprivet/cull/issues/new/choose)
using the **Feature request** template. Describe the problem you are trying to
solve, not just the solution you have in mind — it helps us find the best fit.

## Security Issues

Please do **not** report security vulnerabilities through public issues. See our
[Security Policy](SECURITY.md) for how to report them privately.

## Pull Requests

Because the application source is private, code PRs against this repository
cannot be merged. PRs are welcome only for **documentation fixes** in this repo
(for example, typos in the README or these guidelines). For anything else,
please open an issue instead.

## Code of Conduct

By participating in this project you agree to abide by our
[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
